hero.headline: We're Roof Studio, and we want to meet you.
hero.lead: We've always believed great animation should feel like you could hold it in your hand.
hero.question: Sound like you?

about.label: The invitation
about.title: Creative Talent
about.p1: Every detail considered, every frame earning its place. That's the standard everything we make is built on.
about.p2: We're looking for Art Directors, Designers and Animators who share our passion and obsession with the craft, creativity and excellence in every detail.
about.p3: We believe the best ideas come from a strong creative eye. AI can expand possibilities, open new paths and help turn a vision into image, movement and narrative, but the tool never comes before the idea.
about.p4: We're looking for professionals who bring vision, experience and sensitivity to their work, and who know how to use new tools to take it even further.
